svg.title: Crystal Essence — Prism and Lattice. Draft 3 / Crystal classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Prismatic Focus forks into Razor Lattice then Splintered Mountain Heart, or Flaw in the Stone then Break Along the Flaw. Jade Lattice forks into Flawless Sphere then Adamant Core, or Light Turned Back then Entombed in Crystal. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Crystal jutsu.

Its two Increase Damage Taken rows (Sphere single target, Cave area enemies, both 35% for two rounds) anchor an exposure route, while the 40 AP Crystal Sphere's 35% Decrease Damage Taken and the Cave's 40% Reflect each anchor a defensive route that honours the Defensive trait. Crystal"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Reference reuse: flats follow Taiyo Kami where rows match (Prismatic Focus = Dawnheart; Razor Lattice and Splintered Mountain Heart = Crown of Cinders and Solar Cataclysm; Flawless Sphere and Adamant Core = Golden Mantle and Sovereign Sun), as the kit shares Taiyo's three-row burst and Increase Damage Given / Increase Damage Taken glue. Departures: no Decrease Damage Given or Afterburn rows, so Jade Lattice pairs Decrease Damage Taken with Reflect, and the exposure and Reflect routes use the same +2% / +3% / +5% ladder.","Routes (RUL-2026-10-03-005): Burst +5 Damage on three rows; Exposure +10% Increase Damage Taken on two rows (Prismatic Focus +2%, Flaw in the Stone +3%, Break Along the Flaw +5%); Bastion +10% Decrease Damage Taken and Reprisal +10% Reflect (Jade Lattice +2%, Hidden Art +3%, Advanced Art +5%). Recalibration: Flaw in the Stone +2% \u2192 +3% and Break Along the Flaw +3% \u2192 +5% Increase Damage Taken (route +7% \u2192 +10%; the earlier two-row hold is superseded).","Advanced Art secondaries: Break Along the Flaw, Adamant Core and Entombed in Crystal all carry +3% Increase Damage Given. It is the only kit tag no Hidden Art carries, so it cannot out-bid a sibling purchase; the cost is that three routes share Shipp\u016b's 40% and differ by primary. All 14 legal full builds are non-dominated.","Main tree and passives: for the two rounds after its cast, Shipp\u016b's Increase Damage Given row (Crystal/Earth/Fire/None, Ninjutsu filter) amplifies any Ninjutsu hit and any Crystal, Earth, Fire or element-less hit of any stat type: later Crystal strikes, basic attacks, and any matching normal jutsu or weapon (normal-jutsu catalog unverified). Main-tree or item Increase Damage Given applies as its own multiplier and the bloodline passive (25% + 0.15/lvl) multiplies last (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b). Both exposure rows amplify allies' matching hits too. Pierce ignores Increase Damage Given, Increase Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Taken.","Delivery and uptime: every jutsu has cooldown 7. K\u014dsai Shipp\u016b and Crystal Cave are 60 AP circle spawns on an OTHER_USER target at range 4; Prism is a 60 AP single-target shot; Crystal Sphere a 40 AP single-target cast. Buff and exposure rows are live only in the two rounds after the cast round, so staggered casts give enhanced windows on four to six of every seven rounds. SELF rows (Shipp\u016b Increase Damage Given, Sphere Decrease Damage Taken, Cave Reflect) land on the caster at cast time once the cast has a legal target.","Fourth-purchase choices: Burst (01, 02, 03) adds Flaw in the Stone (exposure 40%) or Jade Lattice (Decrease Damage Taken 37%, Reflect 42%); Exposure (01, 04, 05) Razor Lattice (+2 Damage) or Jade Lattice; Bastion (06, 07, 08) Prismatic Focus (Increase Damage Given 40%, exposure 37%) or Light Turned Back (Reflect 45%); Reprisal (06, 09, 10) Prismatic Focus (Increase Damage Given 40%) or Flawless Sphere (Decrease Damage Taken 40%). Hybrids with no Advanced Art (e.g. 01, 02, 04, 06) spread +2 to +5 over five tags.","Defensive routes and untouched rows: Sphere's Decrease Damage Taken and the Cave's Reflect rows list all four stat types and no element, so each matches nearly every hit the caster takes (Decrease Damage Taken excludes pierce; Reflect includes it and bypasses shields). 45% and 50% stay under the caps (100; Reflect 60% of the hit); the 15% Earth Decrease Damage Taken passive applies last. Prism's wound and the Jade summon are unsupported and get nothing. Skill-tree effects and passives are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING."],"risks":["Classification: Crystal is shared with Sea-Maiden's Kiss (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 5 of 8 kit rows carry Crystal; Crystal Sphere's two rows and Crystal Cave's Reflect row need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Crystal Sphere (and Summoning: Jade, which has no supported row) carry no Crystal row, so they qualify only through an authored Crystal jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Crystal coverage is unverified.","Exposure breadth: +10% makes both Increase Damage Taken rows 45% for two rounds (Sphere single, Cave area); both amplify allies' hits as well as the caster's (pierce excluded), and an enemy under both marks takes both: \u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.10 on a hit matching both filters (e.g. Prism), against \u00d71.35 \u00d7 1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.82 unmodified (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b). Team value was not simulated.","Reflect cap and uptime: 50% leaves ten points of headroom under the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage cap, but main-tree or item Reflect sources add to it and could saturate the cap, wasting part of the +10%. Reflect pays only when the caster is hit during the two rounds after a 60 AP Cave cast; realized value depends on enemy behaviour and was not simulated.","Increase Damage Given stacking: Shipp\u016b's row compounds with any main-tree or item Increase Damage Given (each applies as its own multiplier) and the bloodline passive (about 28.75% at level 25) multiplies last; the +5% maximum lifts Shipp\u016b's row to 40%. Each row stays far below the 100 cap, but the combined per-hit amplification in a Shipp\u016b window was not simulated against peer kits.","Decrease Damage Taken scope: it is a damage modifier and does not touch pierce hits; the Sphere's 35 \u2192 45% window also only exists when the 40 AP cast has a legal OTHER_USER target (any living non-caster user, allies included) in range 4. The exposure half of the same cast is unchanged by the Decrease Damage Taken nodes and lands on whoever is targeted.","Damage calibration: Burst reaches +5 on three rows (Prism 55, Shipp\u016b 45, Cave 45 EP), Taiyo Kami parity at the hard ceiling. By row weight the Exposure build (01, 02, 04, 05) is now the strongest full build, because its +10% lands on two rows.","Delivery and friendly fire: Shipp\u016b's and the Cave's damage and the Cave's exposure reach only enemies on the spawn tiles (friendly fire ENEMIES; no ally-hazard rows); their SELF rows land on the caster at cast time. Prism's damage (ALL) and Sphere's exposure (none = ALL) land on an ally if one is targeted: the Damage nodes raise that hit, the exposure nodes that ally's exposure (45% with 01, 04, 05).","Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. No combat simulation was performed."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":10,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"reflect":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":8,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":2,"reflect":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","reflect"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 3 / Crystal classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Crystal jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Crystal jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Splintered Mountain Heart path + Flaw in the Stone
Break Along the Flaw path + Razor Lattice
Entombed in Crystal path + Prismatic Focus
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE CRYSTAL ESSENCE KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 3 / Crystal classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
